title: The Judgment on Ariel and the Salvation of Zion
description: A prophetic vision over Jerusalem, called Ariel. The Lord warns of siege and distress upon the city, but promises that the enemy army will suddenly vanish like a dream. The people are struck by deep spiritual slumber: the eyes of the prophets are closed, and revelation becomes like a sealed scroll no one can read. They honor God with their lips while their hearts are far away, and their wisdom comes to ruin. Finally, restoration is promised: Lebanon becomes fertile land, the deaf hear the words of the scroll, the blind see, the humble rejoice in Israel's Holy One, the violent one is destroyed, and Jacob's house will no longer be ashamed.
